title: I built a gamified (and competitive) version of the Wikirace game.
author: Puzzleheaded-Help845
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev,

My brother and I have always loved the Wikirace. For the past year I've been building a site that turns it into something more competitive and polished kinda like GeoGuessr did for streetview.

AI has been a massive accelerator on the dev side, and the beta finally went live a few days ago. I was using 3 claude code bot in a same time in VS Code (long live to the Max plan !)

Just wanted to share it with you guys and get some feedback to improve things going forward.

Hope some of you will enjoy !

\> [https://playwikigame.com/](https://playwikigame.com/)

Stack used**:** React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind v4 + Zustand + [Socket.io](http://Socket.io) / Fastify + Node services / Postgres on Supabase + Redis / PostHog + Sentry.
